description: This file defines the UpdateContentTask class, a workflow activity for updating content items within OrchardCore CMS. It includes properties for content item ID, content properties, and publish options, and contains logic for executing content updates with validation and event handling.

classes.name: UpdateContentTask
classes.description: A workflow activity class for updating content items, with properties for content ID, content properties, and publish options, including execution logic with validation and event handling.

methods.name: UpdateContentTask
methods.description: Constructor initializing dependencies for content management, expression evaluation, localization, and encoding.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the activity.

methods.name: Category
methods.description: Returns the category of the activity, which is 'Content'.

methods.name: DisplayText
methods.description: Returns the display text for the activity, 'Update Content Task'.

methods.name: ExecuteAsync
methods.description: Performs the content update operation, including validation, event checks, content property merging, and publishing or saving drafts.
